blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero has offered Manila Rep. Bienvenido Abante Jr. to “rest somewhere else” after the latter was caught dozing while a witness was being examined during the impeachment trial. During the resumption of the trial on Monday, Escudero asked public prosecutor Iloilo Rep. Lorenz Defensor and prosecution spokesperson former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers to “kindly nudge” Abante as he may want to rest “but at least not behind the witness.” READ: Ridon: Undeclared firearms new evidence in Duterte impeachment case Senator-judges were raising questions to Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) […]...
